# Camp: Weather Control Station - Radstorm

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Apr 12, 2025
- 2 min read

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_25dd770188384f099dbb7e5399b06870~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit:

Sunshine is for the birds. Fill your C.A.M.P. with the joy of a Radstorm instead!

Weather Control Station will change weather in the C.A.M.P. radius when connected to power.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Radstorm Weather Station__

Image Credit: Reasonable Madness

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_13e53aabc926403db8bd29235511b9ff~mv2.jpg)

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_f4d95153dea04ac8a5664a8dd38aa649~mv2.jpg)

**Produces**

A Radstorm

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

0 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

All other Weather Control Stations

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Appliances

**Holds**

N/A

**Obtainable via**

Atom Shop - Weather Control Station (Radstorm) - 1400 atoms (TBC)

Atom Shop - Bundle - X atoms

**Produces X amount per**

N/A

**Lockable**

N/A

**Power Required**

2 Power

**Flamingo Units**

1 Flamingo Unit

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_37a8ee666027440d97d4c2ae0b5393e1~mv2.png)

Hey there, I'm Kat, also known as Duchess!

I'm an Aussie data miner who creates guides for farming, events, and food buffs in Fallout 76.

I firmly believe that knowledge should be accessible to everyone, so my guides will always be free. However, maintaining a website and using photo and video editing software can be costly.

If you find my guides useful, here are a few ways you can support me:

- __One-Time Donation:__ Buy me a coffee.

- __Monthly Contribution:__ Become a regular supporter by subscribing to my Ko-fi page.
